items.title: CARD TYPING
items.where: case card and recovery report: the rows being typed out

takes.a: Fast soft typing on a modern low-profile computer keyboard, steady rapid keystrokes, close and dry, no room echo, no voices, no music.
takes.b: A computer terminal printing text on screen: a rapid stream of tiny soft digital ticks, like an old data readout, even and quick, dry, no beeps, no music.
takes.c: An old electromechanical teletype printing a line of text quickly, crisp mechanical chatter, close and dry, no bell, no voices.

items.title: PRISON ROOM TONE
items.where: under every scene inside the prison

takes.a: Room tone of a huge empty concrete prison hall at night: a deep low air rumble, faint distant metallic ticks and a slow water drip far away, cold and still, seamless loop, no voices, no music.
takes.b: Inside an abandoned concrete cell block: low ventilation hum from failing ducts, a faint electrical buzz, long reverberant emptiness, very quiet, seamless loop, no voices, no music.
takes.c: Dead silent underground concrete chamber: only a very low sub rumble and the occasional distant creak of metal settling, oppressive, seamless loop, no voices, no music.

items.title: TENSION BED
items.where: rises in the death row once the prisoner has traded places for the first time

takes.a: A dark sustained horror drone: a low bowed metal tone with slow uneasy movement and a faint high whine, no rhythm, no melody, seamless.
takes.b: A deep pulsing sub-bass tension bed, like a slow distant heartbeat inside a hum, ominous, no melody, no drums, seamless.
takes.c: Cold eerie atmosphere: a low dissonant synth cluster with a faint breathing texture, slowly swelling, no rhythm, no melody, seamless.

items.title: SHIELD REPEL
items.where: KNOX slams the light shield and throws the target back

takes.a: A heavy energy shield shockwave: a short charge-up whine, then a deep concussive whump of force with a bright electric crack, punchy, no voices.
takes.b: A massive blunt force blast of compressed air and light: a deep sub thump with a short shimmering electrical tail, cinematic impact, no voices.
takes.c: A riot shield slammed forward releasing a pulse of energy: metallic clang followed instantly by a low booming pressure wave, tight and powerful, no voices.

items.title: HUD ALERT
items.where: each time a warning banner appears at the top of the feed

takes.a: A short two-tone military interface alert beep, clean and restrained, falling pitch, dry, no reverb.
takes.b: A brief low digital warning tone from a surveillance console, one soft buzz, serious, dry.
takes.c: A quick sharp radar style ping from a tactical display, single ping with a very short tail, dry.

items.title: FEED STATIC
items.where: the surveillance picture tears for a moment (each exchange of places, the beacon replay)

takes.a: A very short burst of analog video static and signal dropout, harsh crackle, abrupt start and stop.
takes.b: A quick digital glitch: a stuttering data-corruption buzz, less than half a second, abrupt.
takes.c: A brief electrical interference zap on a monitor, a sharp crackle with a tiny low thump, abrupt.

items.title: COUNT BELL
items.where: act 2: the count comes out wrong and the block's bell rings

takes.a: An old prison electric alarm bell ringing harshly for two seconds in a large concrete hall, metallic clatter, echoing, no voices.
takes.b: A loud industrial buzzer in an old penitentiary, one long harsh electric buzz with concrete echo, two seconds, no voices.
takes.c: A worn institutional electric bell, weak and uneven as if the power is failing, ringing in a big empty cell block, echoing, no voices.

items.title: ALL CELL DOORS RELEASE
items.where: act 2: FUSE blows the linkage and every cell door on the block comes open at once

takes.a: A row of heavy steel prison cell doors unlocking and sliding open all at once: a loud mechanical clunk of the gang lock, then many barred doors rolling and banging against their stops, concrete echo, no voices.
takes.b: A prison block's cell doors released together: one deep metal lever clank followed by a rippling series of steel bolts snapping back down a long corridor, echoing, no voices.
takes.c: Many iron cell doors swinging open at the same moment in a large concrete hall: groaning hinges and a clatter of metal on metal, reverberant, no voices.
